name: bullswarm
description: Bullswarm inside Claude Code: quota-routed delegation, verdicts on Bash results, and a live workflow pane.

plugins.name: bullswarm
plugins.description: Routes Agent calls to the pool with spare quota, appends the verdict to `bullswarm run` results, and draws the runs strip and the workflow pane. Needs the bullswarm CLI on PATH and CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 (function hooks are early access).
